clusters.name: Walter's move to Sorrel Valley, 1952–1953
clusters.reason: Within a year of Walter's move to Sorrel Valley and buying the orchard in March 1952, June and Edna's daily letters, Walter and June's distance out in the trees, Glen's fights at the new school, Walter's cutoff from his brother Harlan, June's weeks in bed, and the rows with June over money for new trees all sit close together through 1953, with June's turn to the choir in September 1953 as where things settle. Faye's stomach aches and Roy being kept back a year are on dates nobody is sure of, so they are weighed lightly alongside the rest.

clusters.name: Walter's orchard failed, 1968–1969
clusters.reason: Within a few months of the orchard failing in May 1968 and being sold at auction that October, Walter's drinking, the blame between Walter and Glen, Glen and Marian taking over the family's money and the bank talks, Carl's asthma, your bedwetting, and Ida's heart trouble all fall close together into 1969, with Walter's return to steady pruning work in October 1969 as where things settle. Roy's silence toward his father is on a date nobody agrees on and sits alongside without fixing when it opened.

clusters.name: Wilma's move into your house, 1990–1991
clusters.reason: Within a few months of Wilma selling her farm and moving into your house in January 1990, you clashed with her over the children's bedtimes and meals, Hollis worked late and took his mother's side, Owen's tantrums at preschool, Wilma taking over Lily's care, your eczema, and the nightly rows with Hollis all sit close together into 1991, with Wilma's move to her own flat in June 1991 and your eczema clearing that summer as where things settle.
